name: Xala Reef (Costalegre artificial surf reef)
shape_type_notes: No source describes or shows the reef's planform. This polygon is a symmetric footprint ENVELOPE only (not a confirmed chevron/V/delta shape) sized by open analogy to the same designer's only other published reef (Palm Beach Reef). It is not a measurement of Xala itself.
coords: metres; origin = shoreline point nearest the reef centroid (exact shoreline position unknown - Xala's precise coordinates are undisclosed); x = alongshore (positive direction arbitrary/unconfirmed - no source states compass orientation of the reef or shoreline), y = offshore (positive seaward); shoreline approximated as the line y=0

crest_depth_m.datum: below MSL (analogy value; not stated for Xala)
crest_depth_m.confidence_note: Design-analogy estimate only; no Xala-specific source gives a crest depth. Uncertainty large, plausibly anywhere between the surf-zone-minimum needed to be surfable at low tide (~0.5 m) and ~2.5 m.

distance_offshore_m.measured_from: shoreline (analogy value; not stated for Xala)
distance_offshore_m.confidence_note: Design-analogy estimate only; no Xala-specific source gives an offshore distance.

orientation_notes: Completely unconfirmed. No source states which way the reef's arms/apex point, the angle of the structure to the shore, or which compass direction is 'alongshore-positive'. Outcome text for Xala (card `outcome` field) explicitly states no independent surf report exists, so we do not even know whether Xala breaks right, left, or both (Palm Beach, the analogy source, breaks predominantly right with a shorter left in bigger swell, per R7 - but that is Palm Beach's documented behaviour, not Xala's).
materials: Quarried rock/boulders, ~3,000 truckloads (no tonnage or volume figure published) [R3][R4]; not geotextile [R3][R4][R12]

derivation.quote_or_figure: "The dimensions of the reef are roughly 160m long and 80m wide." (Raised Water Research, Palm Beach Reef spot page)
derivation.uncertainty: Order-of-magnitude only. Xala could plausibly differ by ±50% or more; no Xala-specific figure exists to check against.

agree: Materials/construction method (3,000 truckloads of quarried rock, no geotextile) - directly sourced and matches our own card [R3][R4].
Designer identity and Palm Beach Reef pedigree - matches our card [R1][R6].

Directionally, Gemini's numbers are in the same order of magnitude as ours, which is itself telling (see disagree notes below) - both land close to Palm Beach Reef's real 160x80m/1.5m/270m dimensions.

disagree.ours: 160 m (explicitly labeled as a Palm-Beach-analogy estimate, not a Xala measurement)
disagree.why_ours: We re-fetched all 4 of Gemini's own cited sources (Indelicato/Raised Water Research unveiling article, Romeyn/Hollywood Reporter via its Yahoo syndication, the freerepublic repost, and Hospitality Net) on 2026-09-25 and confirmed none contains any length, width, area, or footprint figure for Xala - only the boulder-truckload count. Gemini's Key Technical Specifications section presents '~140 x 75 m' with a tilde but with zero citation tying it to any of the 4 listed references, none of which is an engineering drawing or contains a number close to 140 or 75. The number cannot be derived from Gemini's own source list. Our own value (160m) is at least traceable to a real, cited, quoted figure - Palm Beach Reef's published dimension - and is labeled throughout as an unverified analogy, not a Xala fact.

Same as above - no cited source supports 75 m for Xala. 75 m is suspiciously close to Palm Beach's real 80 m, supporting our own card's 'suspicious' note that Gemini likely performed the same Simon-Mortensen/Palm-Beach analogy internally without disclosing it or citing Palm Beach as the source.

disagree.ours: 1.5 m below MSL (Palm-Beach-analogy estimate, single value not a range)
disagree.why_ours: Palm Beach Reef's crest depth is documented as exactly 1.5 m below MSL (Raised Water Research spot page, quoted above). Gemini's range brackets this exact figure but, again, cites only the 4 Xala-specific sources, none of which mentions a crest depth at all. We present a single analogy value with an explicit large-uncertainty caveat rather than a bare range with no stated method.

Palm Beach Reef sits ~270 m offshore per its own spot page. None of Gemini's 4 cited Xala sources states any offshore distance. Gemini's lower range (180-250 m) may reflect an independent guess or a partial/rounded version of the same analogy; either way it is uncited and we cannot verify it against any source.

disagree.gemini: Not drawn; described only in prose as a 'non-linear Boussinesq refraction wedge' with 'peeling left and right shoulders'
disagree.ours: shape_type 'other' (undetermined footprint envelope only); orientation explicitly flagged as unknown
disagree.why_ours: The 'peeling left and right shoulders' description is not supported by any Xala-specific source; our own verified card's Outcome section states no independent surf report of Xala exists at all, so we do not know if it produces one wave direction or two. This phrase looks like it was generalized from Palm Beach Reef's documented behavior (a right-hander plus a shorter left in bigger swell) or from generic surf-reef design language, not from anything published about Xala.

open_issues: No source found by either this project's exhaustive card/dossier sweep (2026-09-24) or this footprint task's re-check (2026-09-25) discloses any Xala-specific length, width, area, crest depth, or offshore distance.

No aerial photo, plan-view figure, engineering drawing, permit filing, or CAD/scale asset for Xala exists in this project's media indexes, in Gemini's media indexes, or in Gemini's reef_footprints.json (confirmed by direct grep - the Gemini slug 'xala-reef-mexico' has no entry in the structures array at all).

The only two verified images of Xala (both already in the card's `images` list) are close-range, water-level surf action photos with no shoreline, scale reference, or plan view visible - confirmed by direct visual inspection this task.

This entire footprint record is therefore a labeled DESIGN-ANALOGY PLACEHOLDER (to the designer's only other published reef, Palm Beach), not a Xala measurement or a figure-based estimate. It should be replaced the moment a real design paper, permit drawing, or aerial photo of Xala's reef becomes available.
Exact reef coordinates and shoreline orientation are undisclosed, so the coordinate frame's alongshore-positive direction is arbitrary and cannot be tied to a compass heading.

Whether Xala's reef is symmetric, single-armed, or a chevron/V like Palm Beach is completely unconfirmed; the polygon supplied here is a symmetric envelope specifically to avoid asserting an unconfirmed asymmetric/chevron shape.
